heroHeadline: Day 771: Gunmen Shoot Mazatlán Civil Protection Coordinator in Broad Daylight; Two Women Shot Near Escuinapa Highway, One Dead
heroSubtitle: 771 days of cartel civil war — through September 2, 2026: Gunmen on a motorcycle opened fire on the official vehicle of Mazatlán Civil Protection Coordinator Óscar Osuna Tirado in the city's Montuosa sector on September 2, wounding him and a companion despite more than 6,000 troops stationed in the port under 'Operación Sable' — the latest sign that government officials, not only rival cartel gunmen, remain targets in the Chapitos–Mayos fight for the coast. The attack followed the September 1 discovery of two women shot alongside the Mazatlán–Tepic highway near Escuinapa's 'El Tobogán' area; one, identified as Verónica, died at the scene, while the other, Glenda, 28, survived a gunshot wound to the face, with a narco-message left near the body. Both incidents extend the same Culiacán–Mazatlán–Escuinapa corridor driving the state's 2026 violence, days after interim Governor Graciela Domínguez Nava previewed her federal-backed 'Plan Integral de Seguridad y Gobernabilidad' as still in preparation with the federal government, and as the state's homicide and femicide tolls continue to climb.
